payload.headline: Decide plan-v1 mapped statuses for legacy plans marked partial and deferred

parts.cause: DISCUSSION.md §3 agreed on migrating legacy plan statuses, noting the owner decides partial and deferred.

options.does: Sets 261006-1408 to draft and 261007-1800 to withdrawn
options.gain: Both plans satisfy plan-v1 vocabulary while preserving unfinished work visibility
options.harm: Draft plan remains visible in portfolio until resumed or closed
options.label: Map partial to draft, deferred to withdrawn

options.does: Sets both legacy plans to withdrawn
options.harm: Unfinished advisory capability work is archived without separate tracking
options.label: Mark both plans withdrawn

parts.recommendation: Map partial to draft and deferred to withdrawn so unfinished advisory work stays tracked while deferred work is archived.

scope.allows: Updating the status fields of 261006-1408 and 261007-1800 to plan-v1 values
scope.forbids: Changing any other plan status or content

parts.what: Two legacy plans (261006-1408 marked partial, 261007-1800 marked deferred) require owner decision to map to plan-v1 enum.
